Graphic stylized hardware aesthetic matching supplied character reference: bold simplified shapes, matte surfaces, restrained soft bevels. VERY IMPORTANT this is a reusable background only: NO foreground platforms, no floor collision surfaces, no characters, no keys, no pickups, no hazards, no UI, no words or text, no logos.
